args.script: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const lines = text.split('\n').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean); const matches = lines.filter(l => /RTX\s*5090|5090|ab\s*\d|€|UVP|Preis|Starting at|From/i.test(l)); return {url: location.href, title: document.title, matches: matches.slice(0,200), textStart: text.slice(0,5000)}; })()
